description: This file defines the RegistrationClient interface for interacting with Hono's device registration API, including methods to assert device registration status with optional gateway and tracing context.

classes.name: RegistrationClient
classes.description: Interface for a client to access Hono's Registration API, scoped to a specific tenant, providing methods to assert device registration status.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Asserts that a device is registered and enabled, with overloads for including gateway ID and tracing context.
